_coverage_rationale: REF-DEAL-7: Company with quarterly actuals + annual forecast rows + mixed currency/unit labeling in the same XLSX workbook. Tests three failure modes that none of the existing 4 deals exercise: (1) quarterly period labels ('Q1 2024', 'Q3 2024 Actual') vs annual labels ('FY2025E') in identical columns — verifies the system builds correct period_type and picks LTM actuals, not Q1 data, for current state; (2) mixed unit labeling — one sheet in whole dollars, another sheet in $000s — verifies the scale-detection guard prevents a $3,200 (thousands) number from being stored as $3,200 instead of $3,200,000; (3) multi-currency — XLSX has USD revenue and GBP cost-of-goods at a stated exchange rate — verifies the system normalizes to USD before computing burn or gross margin.
_failure_modes_targeted: Quarter-as-current: Q1 actual selected as current_state instead of FY2024 annual actual via timeseries collapse
Quarter-inflation: four quarterly rows reaching resolveV2 alongside the annual and being averaged into a wrong figure
Scale-mixing: $000s denomination fact (value=2200) surviving as revenue instead of the normalized $2,200,000
Multi-currency: GBP burn (£120K) winning over USD-normalized burn ($150K) after timeseries collapse
Forward annual mixed with quarterly actuals: FY2025 projected=$3,800,000 promoted over FY2024 actual=$2,200,000
Unit label guard miss: raw $000 artifact from deck (value=2200) not filtered before resolveV2
_onboarding_status: FIXTURE-READY — fully synthetic, no real deal ingestion required

_fixture_design_notes.timeseries_collapse_rule: All quarterly + annual revenue facts share document_id='doc-synthq-pl-xlsx'. ≥2 distinct period_labels triggers collapse. FY2024 Actual uses temporal_scope='current' (rank=52024) vs quarterly 'historical' (rank=42024). Annual wins deterministically.
_fixture_design_notes.denomination_design: Raw $000 artifact has source_kind='deck' (lower bucket). Normalized xlsx fact has source_kind='xlsx'. selectHierarchyWinner picks xlsx bucket → 2200000 wins.
_fixture_design_notes.currency_design: GBP and USD burn facts share same document_id with distinct period_labels → timeseries collapse. USD fact temporal_scope='current' (rank=52024) beats GBP 'historical' (rank=42024).
_fixture_design_notes.fx_rate: 1 GBP = 1.25 USD. Raw GBP burn = £120,000/month → USD burn = $150,000/month.

slots.company_description: SynthStream Analytics — SaaS analytics platform with quarterly reporting
slots.solution_summary: Real-time stream analytics for enterprise data pipelines

financials._currency_note: Revenue sheet: USD whole dollars. Costs sheet: GBP ($000s). Stated FX rate: 1 GBP = 1.25 USD. All ground-truth values in USD.

revenue.evidence: SynthStream P&L XLSX — Revenue sheet, row='Total Revenue', col='FY2024 Actual'

burn_rate.evidence: SynthStream P&L XLSX — Costs sheet (GBP £000s), row='Total Opex', col='FY2024 Actual'. £1,440,000/year ÷ 12 = £120,000/month × 1.25 FX = $150,000/month USD

quarterly_actuals._note: Individual quarterly revenue actuals — these must NOT appear as current_state revenue. Present in same XLSX doc to force timeseries collapse.

denomination_noise._note: Deck NLP artifact: revenue mentioned as '$2,200' (thousands representation). source_kind=deck. Must NOT survive as resolved revenue.

currency_noise._note: Raw GBP burn fact (£120,000/month). Must NOT survive over USD-normalized burn ($150,000/month).

validation._note: Three behavioral layers: (1) timeseries collapse selects annual over quarterly; (2) projected excluded from primary resolution; (3) denomination + FX normalization enforced via source_kind bucket priority.

extraction_checks.note: Full-year annual actual must win via timeseries collapse over Q1-Q4 quarterly facts from the same document
USD-normalized burn ($150K) must win via timeseries collapse over raw GBP burn (£120K) from the same document
Denomination normalization: xlsx fact (2200000) must win over deck artifact (2200) via source_kind bucket priority in selectHierarchyWinner

noise_checks.label: Quarterly fact does not reach resolved_value for revenue
noise_checks.description: No single quarter value (max $660K) should appear as resolved revenue — if timeseries collapse fails, a quarterly fact leaks through

noise_checks.label: FY2025 forecast not promoted as current-state revenue
noise_checks.sql_filter: metric_key = 'revenue' AND period_label ILIKE '%2025%' AND temporal_scope = 'projected' AND confidence = 'high'
noise_checks.description: FY2025 projected revenue ($3.8M) must be excluded from primary resolution — projected_excluded_count must be ≥1

noise_checks.label: Raw $000 artifact does not resolve as revenue
noise_checks.description: Deck NLP $000s artifact (value=2200) must not survive selectHierarchyWinner — xlsx bucket wins over deck bucket

noise_checks.label: Raw GBP burn does not resolve as burn_rate
noise_checks.sql_filter: metric_key = 'burn_rate' AND currency = 'GBP' AND value BETWEEN 110000 AND 130000
noise_checks.description: GBP burn (£120K) must not survive timeseries collapse — USD-normalized burn ($150K) has higher factSelectionRank via temporal_scope='current'

report_checks.label: current_state.revenue must be FY2024 Actual annual total ($2.2M)
report_checks.note: If system returns a quarterly value or the FY2025 forecast, that is a temporal confusion failure

report_checks.label: current_state.burn_rate must be USD-normalized ($150K/month)
report_checks.note: GBP-only burn would resolve to £120K — if FX conversion fails, the value will be ~20% lower than expected
